visible.title: 400: 'NoneType' object does not support item assignment - Authlib>=1.6.*
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

When authenticating to azure entra https://login.microsoftonline.com/
and using the latest `Authlib, 1.6.*`.

The website shows this message after login 

`400: 'NoneType' object does not support item assignment`

and nothing else.

reverting to `1.5.*` solves this issue. 

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.45
- Python version: python=3.11 on conda
- Operating System: Server running on ubuntu inside docker. Linux cfaf193df011 6.8.0-1044-aws #46~22.04.1-Ubuntu SMP Tue Dec  2 12:52:18 UTC 2025 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linu. Browser on windows. 
- Browser: Chrome 143.0.7499.170

gold.summary: st.login with Entra fails: 400 'NoneType' object does not support item assignment with Authlib 1.6.*; Streamlit 1.45.
hypotheses: known incompatibility with Authlib 1.6.6, fixed in Streamlit 1.52.2
acceptable_next_steps: Point to #13335 / #13389: upgrade Streamlit to >=1.52.2 or keep Authlib <1.6.6
gold.reference: Closed as duplicate of #13335; upgrade to 1.52.2.
